reasoning: Kept both non-overlapping edits: one clarifies that roles and works identify the performer in compact role-description clues, and the other distinguishes prompts asking for a missing name component from prompts asking for the named entity itself. Each edit is supported by one of the two source patches.

edits.target: - Treat terse statements, quoted fragments, and incomplete phrases as information-seeking clues when appropriate. Infer the answer slot from the wording, then use the context to identify the entity or value that satisfies the clue.
edits.content: - In compact role-description clues such as “She played X on screen and Y on TV,” identify the performer being described; treat the roles and works as identifying evidence, not as the answer, unless the prompt explicitly asks for a role or work.

edits.target: - For completion or compound clues, identify the missing shared component that makes the alternatives fit; do not repeat a clue-supplied component or return one full compound. For partial-name prompts, give only the requested unknown name part. Omit components already stated in the question unless they are needed for unambiguous identification.
edits.content: - For completion or compound clues, identify the missing shared component that makes the alternatives fit; do not repeat a clue-supplied component or return one full compound unless the clue asks for the full conventional name of a named entity. For a partial-name prompt that explicitly asks for the unknown component, give only that part; when the answer slot is the named entity itself, return its complete conventional name even if some components appear in the clue.
